involved_tools.name: list-projects

List the LikeC4 projects available in the workspace.

Usage rules:
- Call with no arguments; the tool takes no input properties.
- Use a listed project ID as the project argument for other tools that support project selection.

involved_tools.name: read-project-summary
involved_tools.description:
Provide an overview of a LikeC4 project: configuration, specification kinds and tags, metadata keys, and the IDs, kinds, titles, and tags of its elements, deployment entities, and views.

Usage rules:
- The project parameter is optional and defaults to "default".
- Use this overview to orient yourself before reading individual elements or views.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

involved_tools.name: search-element
involved_tools.description:
Search elements and deployment nodes across all projects by ID/FQN, title, kind, shape, tag, or metadata key. Returns the total match count and the first 20 results.

Usage rules:
- Provide a search string of at least 2 characters.
- Search is case-insensitive.
- Use kind:<value> or shape:<value> to match a kind or shape exactly.
- Use meta:<key> to find elements with that metadata key, or #<value> to find tags containing that value.
- Any other search string is matched against IDs (FQNs) or titles.
- Use IDs from the results with read-element or other tools that accept element IDs.

search.description: Case-insensitive. "kind:<value>" or "shape:<value>" matches a kind or shape exactly, "meta:<key>" elements with that metadata key, "#<value>" tags containing the value; anything else matches id (FQN) or title.

involved_tools.name: convert_time
involved_tools.description:
Convert a time from a source timezone to a target timezone.

Usage rules:
- Provide the required `time` in 24-hour `HH:MM` format and both `source_timezone` and `target_timezone` as IANA timezone names.
- If the user omits either timezone, use `America/New_York` for that timezone.
- Use valid IANA names, such as `Asia/Tokyo` or `America/Los_Angeles`.

source_timezone.title: Source Timezone

target_timezone.description: Target IANA timezone name (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'America/San_Francisco'). Use 'America/New_York' as local timezone if no target timezone provided by the user.
